If an AI pilot is on the agenda at {{company}}, the hard part is usually agreeing what “done” means before anything is built. Our guide breaks it into four steps:

01 Choose a recurring case
02 Record the baseline
03 Agree a completion test
04 Name an owner and a stop condition

The companion guide, Write down what an agent may do (https://uieglobal.com/resources/authority-boundaries/?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pilot-2026-11&utm_content=t3-telecoms), covers the authority boundary. If you have a fault coordination case in mind, send it over and I’ll sketch what a brief for it would look like.
